parts.text: In this experiment, you will investigate a resistance wire. The circuit has been set up for you. Carry out the following instructions, referring to Fig. 3.1. Fig. 3.1

parts.label: a
parts.text: (a) • Connect the crocodile clip to a length l = 90.0 cm of the resistance wire. • Switch on. • Record, in Table 3.1, the value of potential difference (p.d.) V and current I for the wire. • Switch off. • Move the crocodile clip and repeat the procedure for lengths of resistance wire l = 60.0 cm and l = 40.0 cm. [3]

ms.label: 3(a)
ms.text:
V <3.00 (V)
I <1.50 (A) and increasing
V all to 1dp at least and I all to 2dp at least

parts.label: b
parts.text: (b) Complete the column headings in Table 3.1. [1] Table 3.1 l / cm V / I / R / Ω R l / Ω cm

parts.label: i
parts.text: (c) (i) Calculate, and record in Table 3.1, the resistance R of each length l of the wire. Use your readings from the table and the equation R = V I . [2]

ms.label: 3(c)(i)
ms.text:
correct calculations of R
consistent 2 or consistent 3 sig. figs.

parts.label: ii
parts.text: (ii) Calculate, and record in Table 3.1, the value of R l for each wire. [1]

parts.label: d
parts.text: (d) Use your results in Table 3.1 to calculate the resistance R 25 of a 25.0 cm length of the resistance wire. Show your working. You must not carry out an experiment to measure this value. R 25 = ...................................................... Ω [1]

ms.label: 3(d)
ms.text:
R in range 1 Ω to 3 Ω and clear method seen
25
e.g. proportion from other value(s) of R or use of R / l value(s)

ms.label: 3(e)
ms.text:
any one from:
difficult to judge position of crocodile clip,
difficult to measure wire to nearest mm,
contact between wire and crocodile clip not precise,
difficult to interpolate readings on meters between marks

parts.label: f
parts.text: (f) A student finds that, during the experiment, the wire becomes hot because of a high current. He decides to use a variable resistor to prevent this. Complete the circuit in Fig. 3.2 to show a variable resistor used for this purpose in the experiment. You are not required to carry out this experiment. Fig. 3.2 [2]

ms.label: 3(f)
ms.text:
correct symbol for variable resistor
in series and with all circuit elements in correct arrangement
